summary: The old harness cannot reach the new array and object print depth rejections. It also cannot exercise the preexisting Raw child printing behavior in either container.

coverage_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete entry fixes input guards, parse and print calls, and cleanup.
The build recipe fixes the target and library build path.

claims.necessity_reason: A finite array tree with 1001 nested containers can be built using the supported constructors and passed to the target's print operations. The new guard rejects its deepest container, but the old entry obtains every printed tree through a parser that rejects nesting beyond 1000.

before.requirement: Reach the depth-limit rejection when printing an array at depth 1000.
before.reason: The complete old print_array body has no depth-limit rejection.

after.requirement: Reach the rejection when print_array receives an array at depth 1000.
after.reason: The guard returns false at depth 1000, causing the public print calls to fail. The entry constructs no tree; its parser rejects a 1001st nested container, so no fuzz input reaches this guard.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The parser rejects an array once its current nesting depth reaches the limit.
Parsing starts at depth zero and returns no tree after a parse failure.
The supported array append path permits construction of a nested array tree.

claims.comparison_reason: The rejection is added by g0001; the old harness cannot supply the required tree.

claims.necessity_reason: A finite object tree with 1001 nested containers can be built through the supported object creation and append paths. The new print guard rejects its deepest container, while the old entry can print only parser-produced trees.

before.requirement: Reach the depth-limit rejection when printing an object at depth 1000.
before.reason: The complete old print_object body has no depth-limit rejection.

after.requirement: Reach the rejection when print_object receives an object at depth 1000.
after.reason: The new guard returns false at depth 1000. The entry has no object construction path, and parsing rejects the 1001st nested container.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The object parser rejects nesting once its depth reaches the limit.
Parsing starts at depth zero and returns no tree after a parse failure.
The supported object append path permits construction of nested objects.

claims.comparison_reason: The rejection is added by g0002; the old harness cannot supply the required tree.

claims.necessity_reason: Raw is a supported, observably distinct print type that can be placed in an array. The parser never creates Raw items, and the entry has no construction route.

before.requirement: Reach printing of a cJSON_Raw child within an array.
before.reason: print_array sends children to print_value, which supports Raw. parse_value creates no Raw item, so the harness cannot provide one.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete parser dispatch has no Raw-producing case.
The library provides an explicit Raw constructor.

after.requirement: Reach printing of a cJSON_Raw child within an array.
after.reason: The Raw printing route remains available, but the unchanged parser and harness still cannot produce a Raw child.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete parser dispatch still has no Raw-producing case.
Raw items still require explicit construction.

claims.comparison_reason: On both sides, the same parse-only setup prevents a Raw child from reaching the array print path.

claims.necessity_reason: Raw is a supported, observably distinct print type that can be placed in an object. The entry's parse-only setup cannot create that item.

before.requirement: Reach printing of a cJSON_Raw value within an object.
before.reason: print_object sends member values to print_value, which supports Raw, but the parser produces no Raw item.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete parser dispatch has no Raw-producing case.
The library provides an explicit Raw constructor.

after.requirement: Reach printing of a cJSON_Raw value within an object.
after.reason: The Raw member print route remains available, but the unchanged parser and harness still cannot create its input item.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete parser dispatch still has no Raw-producing case.
Raw items still require explicit construction.

claims.comparison_reason: On both sides, the same parse-only setup prevents a Raw value from reaching the object print path.
